summary: What a match count counts when one atom set matches in several orders

values.unique_atom_sets: one per atom set (RDKit uniquify, chematic, Open Babel GetUMapList, CDK uniqueAtoms)
values.ordered_mappings: one per ordered mapping: CC on ethane = 2 (xenosmarts Matcher.count)

processing: Adapter contract is unique atom sets; xenosmarts exposes only an ordered count, so this flag records the API semantics.
